meta.title: RA warns allowed lints that have comments
meta.fix_ref: rust-lang/rust-analyzer#18146 (fix: Remove check that text of `parse_expr_from_str()` matches the produced parsed tree)
meta.build_notes: GitHub release assets rust-analyzer-aarch64-apple-darwin.gz of the weekly tags 2024-09-16 and 2024-09-30; git tag --contains puts the fix first in 2024-09-23, whose release lacks the macOS arm64 asset, so the next release is the post build. The sysroot is the local rustup toolchain (rustc 1.98.1).
meta.notes: Lint attributes were read by re-parsing the attribute's token text as an expression and rejecting the result when its text differed from the input; a comment inside allow(...) made the texts differ, so the allow was ignored. The window is widened to 2024-09-30 because the 2024-09-23 release lacks the macOS arm64 asset (candidate mapping).

settings_note: The issue names no settings; the session keeps checkOnSave off (native analysis only).

files.note: the fix's regression test allow_with_comment (crates/ide-diagnostics/src/handlers/incorrect_case.rs at 6dad8c55) without its comment line '// Yo, sup', which the transformation inserts; the issue shows the code only in screenshots
a library crate around the snippet (package name, version, edition 2021)

repro.steps: The issue's report: a comment placed above the lint name inside #[allow(...)] makes the allow a no-op, so the suppressed warning reappears. Transformation: insert the comment line '    // Yo, sup' inside the allow list (at line 1) of src/lib.rs, which allows non_snake_case for fn foo(_HelloWorld: ()). Probe: the file's pushed diagnostics (textDocument/publishDiagnostics; the pre build does not implement textDocument/diagnostic) of the transformed copy, mapped back to the original lines, must equal those of the original (fresh session and fresh control); the pre-fix build reports the incorrect-case warning on _HelloWorld only in the commented copy.

attempts.summary: Query textDocument/diagnostic (pull): not-reproduced-pre, because the pre build 2024-09-16 answers every pull request with -32601 'unknown request' (pull diagnostics arrived in rust-analyzer between 2024-09-16 and 2024-09-30), so fresh, control and transformed sessions all gave the same error. The pushed diagnostics of the same sessions show the bug: the transformed copy (comment inside allow) received the warning 'Parameter `_HelloWorld` should have snake_case name' (non_snake_case, 4:7-4:18) and the original none. A probe-route error of the case, not a negative result; attempt 2 queries the pushed diagnostics.
attempts.verdict: not-reproduced-pre (pull diagnostics unsupported by the pre build)
